notes: The test statistics exist in this corpus for the first time. Previously the pooled variance and both t-statistics reached the units only as descriptions, because the text layer had destroyed the symbols; they are now transcribed from the rendered page and carry the crop they were read from.

Table I is cited by cell rather than quoted as a row. That is the substantive improvement: the flattened row read identically whichever month a figure belonged to, so a citation to it proved the digits were copied and not that they were read from the right column.

Fidelity is recorded and differs across the corpus. The formulas and Table I are `transcribed` -- readings of an image -- while every text citation remains a verbatim quote. A consumer that ignores the distinction will treat a reading as a quotation, which is the one way this addition could make the output worse rather than better.

Negative and null results keep their standing: the insignificant 5.4 per cent at twelve months, the -0.076 at month 12 that is significant in the opposite direction, and the trading-rule experiment on which the authors ran no tests at all.

One tension the audit surfaced and the output preserves: the paper says no reversal is observed at a one-year formation period while its own Table I reports a significant negative difference at twelve months. Both are now in the corpus, and only the cell citation makes the second visible.
Everything is one paper and one study. The psychological premise cites separate sources but only as this paper characterizes them.
reasoning: All 58 units reached an assertion, so nothing extracted was lost, and this run recovered content the previous one could not reach at all. Two things changed materially. The four test statistics were read off a rendered page rather than the text layer, which had reduced them to characters resembling mathematics, so the corpus now carries the pooled variance and both t-statistics as usable formulas. And Table I was recovered as a grid, so its figures are cited by cell: 0.319 is recorded under month 60 and -0.076 under month 12, mappings that a flattened row cannot carry at all. The abstract and figure captions, absent from the first pass entirely, were recovered by the repair round. Proportions match the paper: the design, the results and the January effect are the largest entries.
